posts.title: Keysight Technologies Soars 20% on Blowout Earnings Beat
posts.content: Keysight Technologies (KEYS) rallied 20% after surpassing Q2 estimates by $0.45 and raising full-year guidance. Strong demand for 5G and AI testing solutions drove a significant revenue beat. Options market activity suggests continued upward momentum. $KEYS

posts.title: Amer Sports Gains on Technical Apparel Strength
posts.content: Amer Sports (AS) rose 8% following a better-than-expected Q4 report, fueled by robust performance in technical apparel segments. Brands like Arc'teryx and Salomon are capturing growing market share. Momentum play with holiday season tailwinds. $AS

posts.title: NVIDIA Short Interest at Record Levels Amid AI Debate
posts.content: NVIDIA (NVDA) short interest now stands at 265 million shares (notional value ~$300B) as bears accumulate positions on AI disruption concerns. Despite this, major firms maintain buy ratings, citing AI infrastructure growth. Volatile setup heading into earnings. $NVDA

posts.title: Meta Platforms Rises 2.7% on Massive AI Capex Plan
posts.content: Meta (META) gained 2.7% after announcing plans to invest up to $66 billion in AI and data center capital expenditures for 2026, including a multiyear deployment of AMD GPUs. This demonstrates sustained confidence in AI monetization. $META

posts.title: Apple Dipping on China Demand Softness
posts.content: Apple (AAPL) slipped 3% this week as analysts point to weakening iPhone demand in Greater China. Supply chain checks indicate potential Q1 production cuts. Could present a buying opportunity ahead of the next product cycle. $AAPL

posts.title: Microsoft Faces AI Disruption Concerns
posts.content: Microsoft (MSFT) is facing headwinds as enterprise AI agents threaten legacy software revenue streams. While Azure AI growth remains solid, investors worry about increasing competitive pressures. Market watching for Q3 earnings guidance. $MSFT
